about: Broker fee and margin presets for the user's account (OrderModelPlan Step 4.2). Data, compiled into the server: adding or correcting a broker is an edit here. Money is in real-world dollars. SEC Section 31 and FINRA TAF are charged at the engine's standing rates (Core/include/FeeSchedule.h) wherever a broker passes them through. 'verified' says whether every figure was read from the broker's own published page on 'asOf'; where it is false, 'notes' says which figures still need checking.

presets.name: Generic zero-commission retail
presets.notes: No broker in particular: the engine's own retail preset, the same terms retail agents trade on.

presets.name: Robinhood
presets.notes: Commission and margin tiers from Robinhood's margin rates page (effective 2026-09-17). House maintenance is Robinhood's usual 25% floor, which it raises stock by stock; not checked.

presets.name: Robinhood Gold
presets.notes: As Robinhood, with Gold's first $1,000 of margin interest-free. The $5 monthly subscription is not modelled. House maintenance not checked.

presets.name: Charles Schwab
presets.notes: Schwab's own pages refused automated reads; the margin tiers (base rate 10.25%, changed 2026-09-18) are from a secondary summary and need checking against Schwab's page, as does the 30% house maintenance. $0 online stock commission.

presets.name: thinkorswim (Schwab)
presets.notes: thinkorswim is Schwab's trading platform on a Schwab account, so its pricing is Schwab's; the same caveats apply.

presets.name: Fidelity
presets.notes: Commission and margin tiers from Fidelity's own page (base rate 10.825%, effective 2026-09-18; the whole balance at its tier's rate). The 30% house maintenance is Fidelity's usual figure, not checked.

presets.name: moomoo
presets.notes: From Moomoo Financial's US fee schedule (updated 2026-10-01): $0 commission, $0 platform fee (a promotion since 2018), SEC fee and FINRA TAF passed through, a CAT fee of $0.000003 a share, long margin 6.8% at every balance. House maintenance not published there; 25% assumed.

presets.name: IBKR Lite
presets.notes: $0 commission on US stocks (secondary summaries; IBKR's pages were not readable). Margin rates not checked: the generic 8.5% stands in until IBKR's figures are entered here.

presets.name: IBKR Pro (Fixed)
presets.notes: $0.005 a share, $1.00 minimum, at most 1% of trade value, exchange fees included (secondary summaries; IBKR's pages were not readable). Margin rates not checked: the generic 8.5% stands in.

presets.name: IBKR Pro (Tiered)
presets.notes: $0.0035 a share at up to 300,000 shares a month, $0.35 minimum, at most 1% of trade value, with exchange fees and rebates passed through (secondary summaries). Clearing fees, volume tiers and margin rates not checked: the generic 8.5% stands in.
